full_judgment: 4. Upon hearing the parties, the trial Court decreed the suit by his judgment and order dated 26-06-2002 and against which, the petitioner preferred Other Class Appeal No. 186 of 1988 before the District Judge, Tangail and the appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Tangail, who allowed the appeal and reversed the judgment of the trial Court on 09-06-1997. Against the aforesaid appellate judgment of reversal dated 09-06-1997, the plaintiff-respondent filed the above Civil Revision before the High Court Division; that the High Court Division made the Rule absolute by the impugned judgment as aforesaid. Hence, is this leave-petition.
